answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. What survives to the sonnet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Every claim climbs the wander of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the plume re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
